title: Walls, fences and structures no higher than 0.75 m within 1.5 m of a driveway meeting the street
text: Walls, fences and other structures truncated or reduced to no higher than 0.75m within 1.5m of where walls, fences, other structures adjoin vehicle access points where a driveway meets a public street and where two streets intersect (refer Figure 3.8a).
notes: Chapter 2 fact parking.sightlines.clear_0_75m_within_1_5m. The street-corner limb is A3.8.7-r1. Figure 3.8a also shows a 1 m x 1 m lot truncation.
